programs.name: Digital Banking Transformation
key_outcomes: Banker digital productivity tools deployed to all 68 RMs
current_risks: Core banking modernization timeline dependency — digital transformation limited by legacy FiServ constraints
CDO and CIO tension on architecture decisions slowing vendor selection
Budget constraint: $18.5M approved; CIO estimates $24M needed for full scope
programs.gate_status: P3 gate passed 2026-03-15; P4 Build gate target Q3 2026

programs.name: Core Banking Modernization
key_outcomes: Replace FiServ Cleartouch (1998 vintage) with API-first modern core
Enable open banking / FDX standard compliance
current_risks: Total cost estimate range $42M–$65M; Board approved $54M with $12M contingency gate
Vendor selection decision gate Q3 2026; Temenos and Finxact in final evaluation
Estimated 3.5-4 year implementation; real-time business benefits deferred
Digital transformation program blocked on core decisions
programs.gate_status: P2 gate in progress; RFP responses evaluated; vendor down-select Q3 2026

programs.name: AML/KYC Enhancement — OCC MRA Remediation
key_outcomes: Transaction monitoring alert volume rationalized by 25%
Enhanced due diligence procedures for high-risk customers documented and deployed
MRA with Commitment (BSA) closed by Q4 2026
current_risks: OCC examiners return Q4 2026; insufficient progress risks formal enforcement action
CDD refresh requires manual outreach to 14,000 commercial customers — operational capacity constraint
Transaction monitoring tuning requires model validation (currently overdue per MRM policy)
Patricia Holbrook is both program lead and sponsor — single point of failure
programs.gate_status: P1 completed; P2 Design gate approved 2026-03-28; OCC progress report due Q2 2026

programs.name: Wealth Platform Consolidation
key_outcomes: Consolidate 3 platforms to 1 (Envestnet or SS&C Advent)
current_risks: Vendor selection not started; Diana Stern is both sponsor and lead — bandwidth constraint
Data migration complexity: 4,200 clients across 3 systems with 10+ years history
Advisor productivity disruption during transition (2 advisors left in 2025 partly due to platform frustration)
Cost estimate preliminary at $7.8M; prior similar implementations ran $12–15M
programs.gate_status: P1 in progress; business case for P2 target Q2 2026

programs.name: Data Governance & Analytics Platform
key_outcomes: 6 unconnected data warehouses consolidated to single governed platform
Credit decision quality improvement: CECL model RMSE −15%
AML detection accuracy improvement feeding fcfi-aml-2026
current_risks: Core banking modernization is upstream dependency — data governance architecture tied to new core
Data governance requires policy and process change (organizational resistance noted from line-of-business heads)
Two programs (AML, Capital) both require data platform to deliver; sequencing conflict
programs.gate_status: P2 architecture in progress; data architecture decision pending core banking vendor selection
